title: 高处作业自测：防坠落十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/06_Test Your Work At Height Safety Knowledge Work At Height Safety Quiz Work At Hei.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/06_Test Your Work At Height Safety Knowledge Work At Height Safety Quiz Work At Hei/src.py

points.K7: 防坠落装备要定期检查
points.S2: 高处存放与取物的人机工效

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在一架人字梯旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a hard hat stands beside a step ladder and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天测一测高处作业安全！
overlay: 高处作业自测：防坠落十问

shots.scene: 阿杰踮脚站在转椅上，伸手够试剂柜顶层的箱子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on tiptoe on a rolling office chair, reaching for a box on the top of a tall cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰站上转椅，去够柜顶的箱子。

shots.scene: 转椅一滑，小研冲过去扶住，箱子晃了晃
shots.prompt_en: The chair starts to roll; the female graduate student rushes to steady it as the box wobbles.
shots.narration: 椅子一滑，差点连人带箱摔下来。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，旁边出现问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head with a question mark icon beside it.
shots.narration: 这也算高处作业吗？先答十道题。

shots.scene: 十张空白题卡，脚手架和梯子图标
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank quiz cards with small scaffold and ladder icons. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题，看看你能答对几道。

shots.scene: 三个场景图标：高台、台阶边缘、地面开口
shots.prompt_en: Three scene icons: a raised platform, the edge of a step down to a lower level and an open hole in a floor. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么叫高处作业？

shots.scene: 高台上的人和高度刻度尺
shots.prompt_en: A person icon standing on a raised platform beside a height ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 达到一定高度的作业，算高处作业。

shots.scene: 从一层掉到下一层、从开口掉下去的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows showing a fall from one level to a lower level and a fall into a floor opening. No people.
shots.narration: 有坠落到低处、掉进开口的风险，也算。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three scene icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 三种都是。

shots.scene: 刻度尺旁一条红线，上方有安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A height ruler with a red line, and a harness icon above the line. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：多高起要防坠落？

shots.scene: 原题答案卡片，旁边国旗式空白标准书
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer card next to a blank national standard book. No people.
shots.narration: 原题按国外规定答一米八。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白标准书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank standard book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 国内按国家标准划分，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 三个人形：心形图标、脑袋图标、闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Three person icons with a heart symbol, a head symbol and a lightning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪些人不能登高？

shots.scene: 健康问题的人形被拦在梯子外
shots.prompt_en: The person icons with health symbols are stopped at the foot of a ladder by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 有心脏病、精神疾病、癫痫的，不能登高。

shots.scene: 没有安全带的人形也被拦住
shots.prompt_en: A person icon without a harness is also stopped at the ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 身体不适或没有防护，同样不能上。

shots.scene: 高台、无护栏的边缘、破损的屋面三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a high platform, an unguarded edge and a cracked fragile roof panel. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：高处作业有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 屋面采光板裂开的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a skylight roof panel cracking. No people.
shots.narration: 易碎屋面和老化材料，一踩就可能塌。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three hazard icons receive green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 三样都是危害。

shots.scene: 安全帽、手套护目镜、全身式安全带、反光背心四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a hard hat, gloves with goggles, a full body harness and a reflective vest. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：高处作业的专用防护是什么？

shots.scene: 全身式安全带亮起，连着挂钩和锚点
shots.prompt_en: The full body harness icon lights up, connected by a lanyard to an anchor point. No people.
shots.narration: 全身式安全带，加上连接件和锚点。

shots.scene: 老李穿好安全带，挂钩挂在头顶上方的锚点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a full body harness and clips the lanyard to an anchor point above his head.
shots.narration: 挂点要牢固，尽量高挂低用。

shots.section_title: 防坠落装备要定期检查
shots.scene: 安全带上挂着空白检验标签，日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A full body harness with a blank inspection tag and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：防坠落装备多久查一次？
overlay: 防坠落装备要定期检查

shots.section_title: 防坠落装备要定期检查
shots.scene: 原题答案卡片：半年
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer card with a half circle clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答半年，那是企业自己的规定。

shots.section_title: 防坠落装备要定期检查
shots.scene: 老李检查织带、缝线和挂钩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the webbing, stitching and hook of a harness carefully.
shots.narration: 每次用前检查，按标准和说明定期检验。

shots.scene: 屋面上没有固定锚点，一人手拉系索的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: On a roof without anchor points, an icon of one person holding another's lanyard by hand is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：没有锚点，能让人拉着吗？

shots.scene: 屋面上拉起一条水平生命线，安全带挂在上面
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal lifeline installed across a roof with a harness lanyard clipped onto it. No people.
shots.narration: 不能！要用生命线来挂安全带。

shots.scene: 老李按图纸安装生命线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a lifeline following a blank drawing.
shots.narration: 生命线要由专业人员按要求设置。

shots.scene: 平台边缘的护栏：顶栏、中栏、挡脚板
shots.prompt_en: The edge of a platform with a guardrail: a top rail, a mid rail and a toe board. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：护栏由哪三部分组成？

shots.scene: 三部分依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The top rail, mid rail and toe board light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 顶栏、中栏、挡脚板。

shots.scene: 护栏挡住人，不需要每人挂安全带
shots.prompt_en: Several workers move freely on a platform protected by guardrails.
shots.narration: 护栏一次保护所有人，优先于个人防护。

shots.scene: 四个选项图标：安全带、生命线、地面工作、护栏
shots.prompt_en: Four option icons: a harness, a lifeline, a person working on the ground and a guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：防坠落的第一步是什么？

shots.scene: 地面工作的图标亮起打勾
shots.prompt_en: The icon of working on the ground glows with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 能不上高处，就不上。

shots.scene: 伸缩杆从地面清洁高处的灯具
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer cleans a high light fixture using an extendable pole while standing on the floor.
shots.narration: 用长杆、降下设备，在地面完成。

shots.scene: 层级图：避免、护栏、个人防护，从上到下
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid with icons from top to bottom: a ground worker, a guardrail and a harness. No people.
shots.narration: 避免在先，护栏其次，个人防护最后。

shots.scene: 扳手从平台边缘滚落的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench rolling off the edge of a platform. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：怎样防止东西掉下来？

shots.scene: 挡脚板挡住扳手，松散材料被捆好
shots.prompt_en: A toe board stops the wrench and loose materials are tied down. No people.
shots.narration: 装挡脚板，把松散材料固定好。

shots.scene: 工具系着防坠绳，放进工具袋
shots.prompt_en: Tools attached with tethers and placed in a tool bag on a worker's belt. No people.
shots.narration: 工具系绳，用工具袋装。三样都对。

shots.scene: 实验室里高高的试剂柜、大型仪器顶部平台
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory with tall storage cabinets and a large instrument with a top service platform. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里也有高处：高柜和仪器平台。

shots.scene: 转椅、纸箱、实验凳三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a rolling chair, a stack of boxes and a lab stool. No people.
shots.narration: 不站转椅、纸箱和实验凳去够东西。

shots.scene: 小研站在带扶手的稳固踏凳上取物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands on a sturdy step stool with a handrail to reach a shelf.
shots.narration: 用合格的踏凳或人字梯。

shots.section_title: 高处存放与取物的人机工效
shots.scene: 柜子分三层：顶层轻物、中层重物、底层大件
shots.prompt_en: A storage cabinet divided into three zones: light items on top, heavy items in the middle at waist to shoulder height, large items at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 重的放中层，轻的才放高处。
overlay: 高处存放与取物的人机工效

shots.section_title: 高处存放与取物的人机工效
shots.scene: 阿杰双手过头举重箱，肩部红色疼痛图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lifts a heavy box above his head with a red pain icon on his shoulder, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 别把重物举过头顶，伤肩又易摔。

shots.section_title: 高处存放与取物的人机工效
shots.scene: 小研站上踏凳，箱子贴近身体递下来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student on a step stool hands a box down close to her body to a classmate.
shots.narration: 贴近身体搬，太重就两人接力。

shots.section_title: 高处存放与取物的人机工效
shots.scene: 频繁取用的试剂放在伸手可及的高度
shots.prompt_en: Frequently used reagent bottles placed on an easy-to-reach shelf at elbow height. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的东西，放在顺手的高度。

shots.scene: 老李检查梯脚防滑垫和铰链
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the anti-slip feet and hinges of a step ladder.
shots.narration: 用梯前检查梯脚、铰链和踏板。

shots.scene: 人在梯上两手一脚或两脚一手接触的示意
shots.prompt_en: A person on a ladder keeping three points of contact, with highlighted hands and feet.
shots.narration: 保持三点接触，面朝梯子上下。

shots.scene: 站在梯子最顶层的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing on the very top step of a ladder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不站最顶层，有人在下面扶稳。

shots.scene: 楼道里工人在高处更换灯管，下方拉警戒带
shots.prompt_en: In a corridor, a worker on a mobile platform replaces a ceiling light while a warning tape cordons off the area below.
shots.narration: 楼里有人高处作业，下方要拉警戒。

shots.scene: 阿杰绕开警戒区走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks around the cordoned area instead of passing underneath.
shots.narration: 学生绕行，不从下面穿过。

shots.scene: 王老师查看工人的空白审批单和证件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank work permit and a blank certificate card held by the worker.
shots.narration: 作业要审批，作业人员要持证。

shots.scene: 有人从梯子上摔下，躺在地上
shots.prompt_en: A person lies on the floor next to a fallen ladder in a laboratory.
shots.narration: 有人摔下来，先别急着搬动。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，阿杰在旁守护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes an urgent phone call while the young male student stays beside the injured person.
shots.narration: 马上打120，报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 悬挂在安全带上的人图标，计时器
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person suspended in a harness with a timer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 挂在安全带上的人，也要尽快救下。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白法规书旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside thick blank law books.
shots.narration: 安全生产法要求高处作业有防护。

shots.scene: 空白证件卡和梯子、脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate card with ladder and scaffold icons. No people.
shots.narration: 登高架设等特种作业，必须持证上岗。

shots.scene: 王老师合上书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以现行文本和本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with fall protection icons.
shots.narration: 十题答完，回顾一下。

shots.scene: 金字塔：避免、护栏、安全带
shots.prompt_en: A pyramid of icons: a ground worker, a guardrail and a harness. No people.
shots.narration: 能避免就避免，先护栏后安全带。

shots.scene: 踏凳、中层重物、警戒带图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a step stool, a heavy box on a middle shelf and warning tape. No people.
shots.narration: 取物用踏凳，重物放中层，下方要警戒。

shots.scene: 阿杰把重箱挪到中层，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the heavy box to a middle shelf and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：这下不用站转椅了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the step ladder.
shots.narration: 脚踏实地，安全登高，下次见！
